item.title: Congo’s Ebola outbreak tops 8,000 confirmed cases as disease remains out of control
item.description: State health officials said 55 new cases had been reported since Wednesday. In all, 890 measles cases have been reported across 39 counties so far this year. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Reuters, The New York Times

item.title: Shipwreck uncovered on Nantucket island during nor'easter storm
item.description: The so-called nor'easter storm has washed up what may be a shipwreck from the 19th century in Massachusetts, local media says. [Confirmado] Fuentes: BBC News, The Guardian, CBS News

item.title: El Papa Leo insta a hacer concesiones por la paz mientras la guerra en Ucrania se prolonga
item.description: A medida que su panorama de mitad de mandato se oscurece y los precios de la gasolina y el diésel se disparan, algunos republicanos que apoyaron la guerra durante meses están cambiando ahora su postura. [Probable] Fuentes: Reuters, The New York Times, The Washington Post
